sources.entry: Course introduction — MySQL for Developers, PlanetScale

summary.title: MySQL for Developers — PlanetScale
summary.one_liner: A free, intermediate course that teaches application developers how to design efficient MySQL schemas, use indexes well, write fast queries, and apply these ideas to real-world patterns.
keywords: how to make mysql queries faster
takeaways: Choose appropriate MySQL data types and design an effective table schema, including avoiding pitfalls of certain types.
Understand how B+ tree indexes work and where to add primary, secondary, composite, covering, and functional indexes.
Use EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE to read query plans and write efficient queries with joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions.
Apply patterns such as cursor pagination, deferred joins, summary tables, and geographic searches to real application problems.
summary.summary: This is PlanetScale's free MySQL course aimed at application developers, suitable for beginners and those needing a refresher. It is organized into four sections: schema design and data types, indexing, writing efficient queries, and practical examples such as pagination and summary tables. Lessons are hands-on, shown in a TablePlus client rather than slides, and the course deliberately skips low-level administration. The page lists the lessons in each section but does not describe their depth in detail.
